title: Muscles, Bones and Joints
summary: The musculoskeletal system: antagonistic muscles, tendons and ligaments, types of joints, and keeping bones healthy.
objectives: I can explain how antagonistic muscles move bones.
I can name types of joints and their movements.
I can explain how nutrition and exercise keep bones and muscles healthy.
misconceptions: Muscles can push as well as pull.
Ligaments and tendons are the same.
Bone health only matters when you are old.
